name: 东方故事I屠龙战记WIN98版
group_note: Same ES/TMI-engine lineage as esI (008-1, '屠龙之战') and es1_win (008) -- 91% file overlap (2092/2305), near-identical adm/obj/master.lpc (only whitespace/comment diffs), no unique game content in the 213 non-shared files (almost all .old/.c~/.bak editor-backup cruft). This WIN98 archive is missing its ENTIRE include/ directory (no globals.h, no config.h -- config.fluffos's 'global include file : <globals.h>' points at a file that was never captured in this snapshot at all, not just misnamed per §7.45), so nothing compiles (every file: 'Cannot #include globals.h'). Since esI is the complete, already-playable version of the exact same game, reconstructing ~30 missing headers for a strictly redundant, smaller/incomplete snapshot isn't worth the risk of subtly-wrong borrowed macros -- marked noboot rather than duplicate-of-byte-identical-archive since the archives themselves differ, but the game content does not.
